decisions.reason: The operating-cost basis does not change the capital-expenditure assumptions; the source message's separate shared-cost decision is already represented under this Requirement.
Selecting the program-level operating-cost range does not change the financing structure, debt-equity split, debt cost, or mezzanine treatment.
The revised operating-cost input may affect calculated outputs, but it does not change the availability-payment sizing targets or justification requirement.
The operating-cost assumption does not change the authoritative site list; the site-list decision is a separate clause already represented under this Requirement.

The source resolves which Opex basis to use but does not change the standing requirement to annotate assumptions and identify their sources; the specific basis remains owned by the operating-cost Requirement.
Resolving the Opex assumption does not alter the requirements for data review, error checking, or modeling quality.
The selected Opex range does not change the government audience, investment narrative purpose, or communication-quality requirements.
The operating-cost basis does not change the model's presentation, understandability, or auditability requirements.
